howToApply: Visit the official website www.npcilcareers.co.in and click on ‘Apply => Online Registration’.

There is NO application fee for applying for the Internship.
Do NOT send any documents/application to NPCIL by post or in person.

howToApply: Visit the official website: https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in
Complete User Registration by entering E-Mail Address, Mobile Number and Captcha, then click Next.
Verify Mobile Number using OTP received on registered mobile number.
Complete Account setup by entering First Name, Last Name, Create Password and Confirm Password, then click SUBMIT.
Verify your email address by clicking the verification link sent to your registered email.
Login using registered email/mobile number and password.
Fill in User Profile with Personal Details (Name, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Address, Language Known, etc.).
From HOME, click ‘Apply Now’ against the desired post/cadre.
Read the detailed advertisement PDF carefully before applying.
Fill in the Application Form with all required details marked with red asterisk (*): Personal Details, Educational Qualification, Experience Details, Document Details.
Enter the auto-generated system code (Captcha).
Read the Declaration and click Yes/No, then click ‘Submit Application’.
Upload Photograph (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 150 KB, 5cm height x 3.6cm width) and Signature (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 50 KB, 2.5cm height x 7.5cm width, black/blue ink on white paper).
Preview the application form, verify all details, and click Confirm.
Download and print the confirmed application form for future reference.
Note: Once confirmed, no changes can be made to the application.
